---
title: "Gravity controlled models"
---

The gravity controlled (vrij afwaterend) models cover 11 water authorities: Aa en Maas, Brabantse Delta, De Dommel, Drents Overijsselse Delta, Hunze en Aas, Limburg, Noorderzijlvest, Rijn en IJssel, Stichtse Rijnlanden, Vallei en Veluwe and Vechtstromen.
Most of their water drains freely, over weirs and through streams, and their model is built from a detailed network.
Sweco made their first input models in 2024, and the pipeline now makes these from the source data.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "The stages of a gravity controlled model, with the model that each script writes."
flowchart LR
  subgraph lumped["lumped"]
    direction TB
    lump["00b_lump_model.py<br>&lt;authority&gt;_2024_6_3"]
  end
  subgraph parameterized["parameterized_&lt;authority&gt;"]
    direction TB
    fix["01_fix_model.py<br>_fix_model"] --> prepare["02_prepare_model.py<br>_prepare_model"]
    prepare --> param["03_parameterize_model.py<br>_parameterized_model"]
  end
  subgraph bergend["bergend_&lt;authority&gt;"]
    direction TB
    control["04_add_full_control.py<br>_full_control_model"] --> storage["05_add_bergend.py<br>_bergend_model"]
  end
  subgraph dynamic["dynamic"]
    direction TB
    forcing["07_add_dynamic_forcing.py<br>_dynamic_model"]
  end
  lumped --> parameterized --> bergend --> dynamic --> merge["samenvoegen"]
```

The code is in [`src/ribasim_nl`](https://github.com/Deltares/Ribasim-NL/tree/main/src/ribasim_nl).
The scripts numbered 01 to 04 are per authority, for instance in `pipeline/aa_en_maas`, and the others are shared.
Only the last model of each stage is an output of DVC.

## 1. The input model

`pipeline/00a_process_hydamo.py` applies the manual changes to the HyDAMO data of 7 water authorities, and `pipeline/00b_lump_model.py` lumps the data of 10 into an input model.
`pipeline/noorderzijlvest/00_lump_model.py` lumps the D-HYDRO model of Noorderzijlvest.
[Lumping](lumping.qmd) shows this step by step, and [Reproducing models](../dev/reproducing-models.qmd) how they keep the IDs of the models that Sweco made in 2024.

## 2. Fix

`01_fix_model.py` corrects the input model `{authority}_2024_6_3` by node ID, into a valid Ribasim model `{authority}_fix_model`.
It is the same step as in [Lumping](lumping.qmd#correct-the-model-in-the-fix-script), and most of the edits are in `verwerkt/model_edits.gpkg`.

## 3. Prepare and parameterize

`02_prepare_model.py` reads `{authority}_fix_model`, adds `levels` and `flow_rate`, and writes the model as `{authority}_prepare_model`, and a template for the parameters to review, `verwerkt/parameters/static_data_template.xlsx`.
`03_parameterize_model.py` reads `{authority}_prepare_model` and the reviewed `static_data.xlsx`, and writes `{authority}_parameterized_model`.

ManningResistances get the DAMO profile of their link if it lies across one of their links.
Without a profile of their own watercourse, they get a trapezoid with the width of the BGT water along their links, see `ribasim_nl.parametrization.manning_resistance_table`; the source is in `meta_profile_source`.
When the links are routed along the waterways in the last step, their BGT width follows the routed links.

## 4. Control

`04_add_full_control.py` gives the Outlets and Pumps one of the [functions](control.qmd) `drain`, `supply`, `flow_control` or `flushing`, and adds its DiscreteControl node.

It also writes steady state variants of the model, `<authority>_steady_state_dry` and `_wet`, with constant forcing.
Each script has a flag `MODEL_EXEC` to run and check these while working on the model, which is off in the pipeline.

## 5. Storage basins

`pipeline/05_add_bergend.py` limits the supply to the target level, and adds a [storage basin](storage-basins.qmd) to each Basin, based on Van der Gaast.

## 6. Forcing

`pipeline/07_add_dynamic_forcing.py` adds the [forcing, foreign inflows and wastewater](forcing.qmd), and finishes the model with `ribasim_nl.regional_model.finish_regional_model`:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  layout["Route links,<br>tidy the layout"] --> levels["Summer and<br>winter levels"]
  levels --> write["Write and<br>validate"]
  write --> run["Run"]
  run --> state["Use the final state<br>as initial state"]
  state --> check["performance.xlsx,<br>output_controle.gpkg"]
```

These steps are shared with the [level controlled models](level-controlled.qmd).
The result, `<authority>_dynamic_model`, goes on to the [coupling](couple.qmd).

## Scripts outside the pipeline

Two scripts in the `notebooks` folder are run by hand, and are not part of the DVC pipeline:

- `06_add_synthetic_forcing.py` adds synthetic forcing (constant precipitation switched to constant evaporation) to `{authority}_full_control_model`, into `{authority}_synthetic_forcing_model`.
- `uploaden_modellen.py` copies the selected `{authority}_dynamic_model`, runs it, runs Delwaq on it, and uploads it to [The Good Cloud](../cloudstorage.qmd).
